name: Chef AI: Fridge Recipes
tagline: Recipe ideas built from the ingredients you already have.
storage_summary: Your pantry, recipes, meal plans and profile are stored only on your device.

ai_consent.withdraw: Settings → Chef AI → Share data with AI

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.purpose: Generates recipes, meal plans and cooking answers, and estimates calories from food photos.
openai.data: the text, transcribed voice, receipt text and food photos you submit to AI features, plus the dietary profile and goals used to tailor results

magichour.name: Magic Hour
magichour.purpose: Creates a thumbnail image for a recipe.
magichour.data: a short text description of the recipe — no photos and no personal data

apple_speech.name: Apple (Speech Recognition)
apple_speech.purpose: Turns your voice into text when you speak ingredients or cook-mode commands.
apple_speech.data: the audio of your voice input, while you are speaking

firebase.name: Google Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config)
firebase.purpose: Tells us which features are used, reports crashes, and delivers app configuration. Never used for advertising or cross-app tracking.
firebase.data: in-app usage events, device model, OS version, app-generated identifiers and crash logs

data_sent.what: Ingredients, recipe requests and chat messages you type or speak
Dietary profile and goals you enter (e.g. diet type, allergies, calorie target)
data_sent.why: Tailor recipes and meal plans to you

data_sent.what: Food photos you choose to scan
Text read from a receipt you scan (the photo itself is read on your device and not uploaded)
data_sent.why: Add grocery items to your pantry

data_sent.what: A text description of a recipe
Voice audio while you use voice input
Usage events, device model, OS version, app identifiers
data_sent.why: Understand usage and improve the app

stored_on_device: Pantry items, saved recipes, meal plans, grocery lists and cooking history.
Cached AI responses and recipe images, which you can clear in **Settings → Clear Specific Data**.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account — the app has no sign-in.
Your advertising identifier (IDFA), location, contacts or browsing history.

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.why: to scan receipts and food photos. Receipts are read on your device; food photos are sent to OpenAI only if you have agreed to AI data sharing.

permissions.name: Microphone and Speech Recognition
permissions.why: for voice ingredient input and hands-free cook mode. Audio is converted to text by Apple's speech service.

permissions.name: Reminders
permissions.why: to add your weekly grocery list to the Reminders app. The app only writes that list and does not send your reminders anywhere.

permissions.name: Apple Health
permissions.why: to personalise nutrition targets and log the calories you record (see section 4).

health.read_why: used on your device to personalise nutrition targets, show progress and decide when to offer a post-workout meal idea.
health.write_why: saved to Apple Health with your permission.

your_controls: **Withdraw AI consent** in *Settings → Chef AI → Share data with AI*. After that, nothing more is sent to OpenAI or Magic Hour until you agree again.
**Revoke Apple Health, Camera, Microphone or Reminders access** in iOS Settings.
**Delete your data** in *Settings → Clear Specific Data*, or by deleting the app.

subscription.restore_location: on the Premium screen, or in Settings → Subscription

support_faq.q: The AI feature asks me to agree before it works. Why?
support_faq.a: AI features send what you type, say or scan to OpenAI (and a recipe description to Magic Hour). We ask first so you know exactly what is shared. You can change your mind in **Settings → Chef AI**.

support_faq.q: A recipe or calorie estimate looks wrong.
support_faq.a: Recipes and nutrition are generated by AI and can be inaccurate. Always check ingredients, allergens and quantities before cooking or relying on the numbers.

support_faq.q: Apple Health numbers are not showing.
support_faq.a: Open iOS **Settings → Privacy & Security → Health → Chef** and turn on the categories you want to share.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Use **Settings → Clear Specific Data** in the app, or delete the app. Your data lives on your device, so this removes it completely.
